title: Instructions for an Orbit
statement: A tower rises like a command, while a flamingo bends it into a question. Earth, flower, and mirror turn the scene from obedience into interpretation: each orbit is a path made after the rule has ended.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent where following an instruction ends and interpreting it begins.

actions.title: Instructions for an Orbit
actions.statement: A tower rises like a command, while a flamingo bends it into a question. Earth, flower, and mirror turn the scene from obedience into interpretation: each orbit is a path made after the rule has ended.

notes.note: Establish a dark cosmic field, then stage a rigid architectural wedge against organic and bodily figures so the composition can pivot from command-like geometry into imaginative association.

actions.title: Instructions for an Orbit
actions.statement: A tower rises like a command, while a flamingo bends it into a question. Earth, flower, and mirror turn the scene from obedience into interpretation: each orbit is a path made after the rule has ended.

notes.note: Sharpen the pivot between command and interpretation: introduce borrowed poster language as a rigid signal and a contemplative human silhouette as the reader who turns the cosmic stage into meaning. Tighten the flower’s white margin afterward if needed.

The central constellation is coherent, but the exposed paper strip beneath the lunar ground weakens its sealed, stage-like atmosphere. Extend the Earthrise field to make the moon’s horizon a complete floor for the figures.

The finished collage has a deliberate instructional hierarchy—isolated poster fragments and vertical architecture—interrupted by the reader, flamingo, flower, mirror, and Earthrise. The remaining black space functions as the unprescribed area where interpretation can occur; title and statement are already present.
